My wasm32 check surfaced that #2959's `verify_nutzap_dleq_against_keyset` was ungated while its only production caller is `#[cfg(feature = "native")]` — dead code on `--no-default-features`. **Verified pre-existing on clean origin/master.** Added `#[cfg(any(feature = "native", test))]`; wasm32 build is now warning-clean.
 [...]    - `verify_dleq` (line 134) builds `cashu::BlindSignature{..}` and calls `.verify_dleq(mint_pk_c, b_prime_c)` — zero hand-rolled challenge in any production path.
   - `dleq_challenge` is now `#[cfg(test)] pub(crate)` (line 184) with `use sha2` *inside* the fn; `sha2` is in `[dev-dependencies]` only (Cargo.toml L78-84). No production sha2.
   - **Single formula source**: `mint_http_support::prove_dleq` (`#[cfg(test)]`) calls `crypto::dleq_challenge` (L77), and swap.rs's `mint_signatures_for_swap_with_dleq` now calls the shared `prove_dleq` (L154) instead of the pre-rebase inline copy. Both test provers → one transcript. Cleaner than pre-rebase. [...] 4. **wasm cfg-gate is correct AND is a legit fix, not rebase damage** ✓
   - `#[cfg(any(feature="native", test))]` on `verify_nutzap_dleq_against_keyset`. Only real callers: the native-gated `verify_nutzap_dleq` wrapper + the 3 unit tests (the two nmp-wallet mentions are doc-comments, not calls). Nothing on wasm needs it.
   - Origin check: merged #2959 (b02f4df7a) declared this pure fn `pub(crate)` with **no** cfg gate while its sole caller is native-only — i.e. #2959's split is what created the dead-code-on-wasm condition. #2964's gate *fixes* that latent #2959 issue; the rebase did not introduce it and it isn't masking anything.
